results.title: The Spiral
results.overview: On a stormy night in Rome, Anna arrives at her daughter Alice’s apartment with a devastating confession: their entire family history is built on a lie. Twenty years earlier, after a horrific accident that nearly cost Alice her leg, Anna claims she made a pact with a mysterious Stranger to save her. But the miracle came at a price. What she believed was a single desperate bargain has in fact unleashed a spiraling chain reaction — a domino effect of increasingly dark events that have haunted their lives ever since. Now, the Stranger has come to collect. And Anna is convinced that only Alice can break the spiral and set things right. But at what cost?

results.title: All American Girls
results.overview: Directed by Conduit Films' founder Christy Wegener, All American Girls features a sit-down with Pleasant Rowland, as well as never-before-seen footage and insights from the American Girl brand's authors, insiders, enthusiasts and journalists. Stop-motion graphics aid the filmmakers as they venture behind the curtain of the brand, which shaped the lives of generations of Americans in the ’80s, ’90s and early 2000s, and maintains cultural relevance today.

results.title: Tumbleweed
results.overview: A mysterious stranger enters an unknown tavern. There he must accept his fate.

results.title: The Mage
results.overview: A series of deaths suddenly occurs in the city. Police officer Wong Ming realizes that at the scene of each death, there is the figure of a woman who collects garbage. In the course of investigation, Wong discovers that this woman, Lan Pui Ching (played by Josie HO), has the mysterious ability to collect the souls of the accidental deaths from the garbage and help these souls to enter the reincarnation. This all started with a story that happened to her 13 years ago. Meanwhile, the murders continue to happen. Lan Pui Ching deduces that these murders are related to a mysterious cult ritual, and she and Wong Ming will be the next victims of this ritual. Wong Ming decides to cooperate with Lan Pui Ching to find out the mastermind behind the scene.

results.title: Um Tio Quase Perfeito 3
results.overview: Uncle Tony feels increasingly abandoned by his nephews, who have grown up and become independent. Then, one day, a baby is left on his doorstep. Uncertain of what to do, he calls on them, and together they hatch wild schemes to find the child's parents.

results.title: Fernanda
results.overview: A portrait of one of Brazil’s greatest actresses, centered on the one thing inseparable from her identity: her craft. The documentary follows Fernanda Montenegro through her most recent work while looking back at the past to trace the making of a great actress over the course of her career. Directed by Pedro Waddington, son of filmmaker Andrucha Waddington—Fernanda’s son-in-law—the film embraces their family relationship as part of its narrative, capturing intimate moments with the actress backstage and unveiling previously unseen footage of projects made together as a family.

results.title: Inolvidable Heidi
results.overview: Heidi, a magical girl from the mountains who lives with her grandfather, her friends, and her rabbit Nicanor, captivates Franco, a young man from the city, with her natural charm. Franco begins sneaking away from his girlfriend, his friends, and even his teacher, just to go see this mountain girl who has stolen his heart. Despite the difficulties and his girlfriend’s interference, their love blossoms. However, an accident and a spell cause them to forget their love. Years later, fate brings them together again. They don’t remember each other, but the same love still lies dormant within them. A love story that defies memory and endures through time.

results.title: Race to Monte Carlo
results.overview: This is the story of the visionaries behind Russia's first mass-produced automobile. In 1908, automotive enthusiast Andrey Nagel and engineer Dmitry Bondarev gather a team of like-minded individuals and begin developing a car. When the viability of their endeavor looks uncertain, Andrey Nagel makes the risky decision to enter their car in the Monaco Rally - a move that could make or break the budding automobile manufacturer's future.

results.title: Mommy Blue
results.overview: The story revolves around Krisztina, an art teacher who is progressively losing her sight as a complication of diabetes. It engenders a crisis, not only in her own life but also in that of her son. Máté must contend with the state of his mother’s health immediately following the birth of his first child. He does his best to help Krisztina, but his life is gradually torn between his increasingly clingy mother and his own little family. Krisztina, meanwhile, fears being alone in the dark…

results.title: Wounds
results.overview: Caleb, a young SFX makeup artist struggles to create realistic effects until he witnesses a brutal murder. Intrigued by what he saw, he descends into a psychological abyss as he takes on extreme measures to create his masterful effects.

results.title: The Beast
results.overview: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the United States, the president must fight back by utilizing the highly classified offensive capabilities of his armored limousine, nicknamed The Beast.

results.title: Ducks
results.overview: A young Frenchman of Cambodian origins goes to his country in search of himself.

results.title: Grow
results.overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

results.title: Nightmare Hospital
results.overview: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

results.title: It Was All Her!
results.overview: Talented as a child but completely lost in her thirties, Vasya suddenly realizes she's heading for rock bottom and has no strength to escape. Malvina, an imaginary friend from childhood, comes to his aid, a freakish woman with purple hair and a quirky sense of humor. Malvina pushes Vasya to find her childhood love, Stasik. Vasya will go through a long journey and understand what went wrong in her life, but most importantly, she will learn why Malvina appeared.

results.title: Dusk Chorus
results.overview: David Monacchi, a hi-tech explorer, knows the Amazonian forest well, but his means of exploration are unusual. A sound artist, “field recorder”, and eco-acoustic composer, he understands terrain through sound. For the sound landscape of this region is as rich as the diversity of wildlife that produces it. Today, global warming and humans are threatening species, and sound pollution itself is involved in the extinction of some of these; nature being well constructed, the sound spectrum of the forest is based on a subtle balance, in which each species communicates on a very specific frequency, never interfering with the others. The upheaval caused by man, through the installation of a pipeline for example, upsets this balance.

results.title: Echoes from Below: Exploring Britain's Caves
results.original_title: Echoes from Below: Exploring Britain's Caves
results.overview: This documentary film heads inside the deepest shaft ever discovered in Britain - Titan. Will a comprehensive 3D scan reveal the shaft’s true size for the first time and help explain how it formed millions of years ago? Or will its vast size prove to be too much of a challenge for the scanning team?  The importance of caves throughout British history is investigated; the discovery of the earliest human skeleton in Britain in Cheddar; the 17th-century Witches’ Marks at Creswell Crags; modern-day cave dwellers at Kinver Edge; and the very first cave divers at Wookey Hole.

results.title: Project Arc: An Arc Raiders Fan Film
results.original_title: Project Arc: An Arc Raiders Fan Film
results.overview: After Malt kills his partner during an extraction, Tian Wen marks him for death. Under the guise of an important retrieval mission, she sends Milo topside alongside Malt to recover a valuable tape. As the two Raiders fight their way across the surface, their uneasy partnership develops into a genuine friendship. With extraction drawing closer, Milo must decide whether or not to carry out his mission.
